response_format: Return one JSON object, for example: {"utterance":"your next spoken turn","action":"continue"}. Choose one action: continue advances the exchange; clarify addresses confusion or a stalled answer; close ends it. Only utterance is spoken; action is private. Return JSON only and escape quotes inside strings.
first_turn: Begin with the exact supplied opening and action continue.
following_turn: Continue from the latest patient turn. Close when the exchange reaches a useful stopping point; the round limit is not a target.
repair_limit: There have been several clarification turns. Consider whether another explanation or cue would help, or whether to set the issue aside or close.
last_turn: This is the last available turn. End with action close, based on what actually happened. Do not ask another question or claim unobserved success.
format_repair: Return the corrected draft as one complete JSON object with exactly utterance and action. action must be continue, clarify or close. Preserve the intended spoken content where clear; if incomplete, finish consistently with the current instructions. Escape quotes inside strings. No commentary, markdown or extra fields.
